summary: Ghostfolio is a self-hosted platform designed for personal wealth management and portfolio tracking. It allows you to monitor assets such as equities, exchange-traded funds, and digital currencies from a single interface. The application helps you maintain an overview of your financial holdings on your own infrastructure.
goodFor: Privacy-conscious individuals who prefer to consolidate their asset tracking locally rather than relying on commercial third-party services.
watchOut: You will need to manually import or maintain your transaction data, as direct automated bank integrations may be limited depending on your region and asset types.
deployNotes: As a containerised Node.js application, it typically requires persistent storage for database records and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
